question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**draconian**" means excessively harsh and severe. (क्रूर)
 
• Example: The new law imposes draconian penalties on those who violate traffic rules.
 
• In the context of the passage, the opposition labeled the decision as a **"draconian law"** to imply that it was unfairly harsh and severe.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**' i.e. 'draconian'.

**Complete Sentence:** *They called this decision a draconian__ law and wanted the government to roll it back.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Comprehensive (व्यापक)**: Including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something. 

 
 
• **Example:** The report provided a comprehensive overview of the project's progress.
 
 
 
• **Fragile (नाज़ुक)**: Easily broken or damaged. 
 
 
• **Example:** Be careful with that vase—it's very fragile.
 
 
 
• **Like (समान)**: Having similar traits or qualities. 
 
 
• **Example:** People of like interests usually get along well.
